The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms present in the source document. All dates, entity names, addresses, facility types, and transaction details are correctly stated or appropriately marked as "N/A" when information is not available in the source document. The memo properly identifies this as a termination notice rather than a complete credit agreement, which explains why many financial terms are not available. MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all the key financial terms that are available in the source document. The source document is a termination notice rather than a complete credit agreement, so it inherently lacks comprehensive deal terms like loan amounts, interest rates, covenant details, etc. The memo correctly acknowledges this limitation and includes all material information present in the source:

- Original agreement date (July 29, 2016)
- Termination/prepayment date (May 6, 2022)
- Administrative agent (Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc.)
- Facility type (Revolving Credit Agreement)
- Borrower details (Snap Inc.)
- Key parties involved (JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., Deutsche Bank AG)
- Letter of Credit continuation arrangements

The memo appropriately notes that comprehensive deal terms are not available in the provided documentation, which accurately reflects the nature of the source document.
